facts.text: Lunch is on me, mate, but I'm washing my hands first. Twice. Then I'll see to the loo.
facts.why: No transcript line or quote page has Kenny saying this, so it should not sit in quote marks. It is rewritten as an unquoted note in his voice, true to a portable toilet man who is proud of clean work.
facts.fix: Lunch is on me. Hands washed twice first, then I'll check the loos.
